title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: a Past due value the chip does not offer reads Any
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  2. Copy the page address.
  3. In the address bar, replace the 31-60 after "pastDue=" with 5.
  4. Press Enter.
  5. Paste the copied address into the address bar.
  6. In the address bar, replace the value after "pastDue=" with any.
  7. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chip reads "Past due: 31-60 days".

Step 2:

  • The copied address carries "pastDue=31-60".

Step 3:

  • The address bar shows "pastDue=5".

Step 4:

  • The report loads normally.
  • The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style.

Step 5:

  • The copied address shows in the address bar.

Step 6:

  • The address bar shows "pastDue=any".

Step 7:

  • The report loads normally.
  • The chip reads "Past due: Any".

The tester edits only the Past due value in the copied address.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-N3: “A Past due value in a link that the chip does not offer (for example 5, or "any") is read as Any.”
  • S5-R15: “The Past due chip and its open menu are the same native checkbox dropdown as Customer and Location: label "Past due", an hourglass icon, an "Any" row, the native line "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow." while none is ticked, then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days", in that order; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the range when one is (for example "Past due: 91+ days"), and "Past due: N ranges" when N are. Ticking all four reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any, because Any also keeps invoices and bills that are not due yet. The ranges are the reports' own aging buckets: 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and more than 90 days past the due date on the as-of date.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D16: “Past due tokens 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-plus on the wire and in the URL”
  • Tech plan §6 Phase 1, unit tests: “invalid location ignored / all-invalid → All; pastDue=5 → Any;”
